nodes.name: Execute Sub Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by Package Router. Receives: { mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path, processing_job_id, source_platform, address, city }

nodes.name: C1 -- Launch MipMap
nodes.notes: Runs mipmap_launcher.py to launch MipMap in fire-and-forget mode. Returns JSON stdout with workspace_path, pid_file. Exit 0=launched, 1=fatal, 2=partial.

nodes.name: C1 -- Parse Launch Result
nodes.notes: Parses mipmap_launcher.py stdout JSON. Extracts workspace_path. Checks exitCode. Passes through all trigger params.

nodes.name: Stop on Failure
nodes.notes: Terminal node for any failure in Path C. Returns status, failed_step, exit_code, and mission_id.

nodes.name: C2 -- Build Ortho Path
nodes.notes: Constructs MipMap output check path: MIPMAP_WORKSPACE\mission_id\result. Tracks poll_attempt via workflow static data. Max 120 attempts = 2 hours at 60s intervals.

nodes.name: C2 -- Check Ortho Exists
nodes.notes: Windows batch command to check if any .tif file exists in MipMap result directory.

nodes.name: C2 -- Set Failed (Timeout)
nodes.notes: MipMap did not produce output within 2 hours. Returns failure with poll attempt count.

nodes.name: C2 -- Wait 60s
nodes.notes: Poll every 60 seconds for MipMap GeoTIFF output. Loops back to C2 -- Build Ortho Path.

nodes.name: C3 -- Find Ortho File
nodes.notes: Lists .tif files in MipMap result directory to get the actual filename (could be orthomosaic.tif, dom.tif, etc).

nodes.name: C3 -- Build Harvest Command
nodes.notes: Constructs full source path by combining ortho_check_dir + filename from dir command. Passes through mission_path, mission_id, processing_job_id for ortho_harvester.py.

nodes.name: C3 -- Harvest Ortho
nodes.notes: Runs ortho_harvester.py to copy GeoTIFF from MipMap workspace to mission output folder. Exit 0=success, 1=fatal, 2=partial.

nodes.name: C3 -- Parse Harvest Result
nodes.notes: Parses ortho_harvester.py stdout JSON. Checks exitCode. Extracts destination_path.

nodes.name: C4 -- Check Vegetation Flag
nodes.notes: Fetch vegetation_analysis flag from drone_jobs. If true, trigger Path E vegetation analysis.

nodes.name: C4 -- Done (No Vegetation)
nodes.notes: Path C complete without vegetation analysis. Mapping ortho harvested successfully.

nodes.name: C4 -- Trigger Path E
nodes.notes: POST to /sentinel-vegetation-trigger to kick off Path E vegetation analysis pipeline.

nodes.name: C4 -- Path C Complete
nodes.notes: Path C complete with vegetation analysis triggered. MipMap ortho harvested and Path E webhook fired.

_meta.description: Path C sub-workflow for mapping mission processing. Launches MipMap, polls for GeoTIFF output (120 attempts x 60s = 2 hours), harvests the orthomosaic via ortho_harvester.py, and optionally triggers Path E vegetation analysis. Called by Package Router Execute Sub Workflow node.

parameters_expected.folder_path: Full path to mission folder on disk
parameters_expected.processing_job_id: UUID of the processing_jobs row for status reporting

_meta.node_sequence: Trigger -> C1 (Launch MipMap) -> C2 (Poll for GeoTIFF, 120x60s loop) -> C3 (Find + Harvest Ortho) -> C4 (Check Vegetation Flag -> Trigger Path E or Done)
